dish: Omu-taco — taco rice wrapped in fluffy omelette egg (sweet/medium/curry/chili-bean meat, 13 toppings)
n: Taco Rice Café Kijimunā, Senaga-jima Umikaji Terrace (タコライスcafe きじむなぁ 瀬長島ウミカジテラス店)
w: The Umikaji Terrace branch of Kijimunā, the shop that created 'omu-taco' (taco rice under a soft omelette) in Onna in 2003 and has since won awards at Okinawa gourmet festivals. Rurubu picks it among Umikaji Terrace's recommended eats and Okinawa Traveler includes it in its seven popular taco-rice shops.

dish: Kume-jima kuruma-ebi (tiger prawn) dishes; ikasumi-jiru (squid-ink soup) and tebichi-jiru add-ons to lunch
n: Restaurant Namiji, Kume Island (レストラン波路)
address: 548-32 Janadō, Kumejima, Shimajiri District, Okinawa, Japan
w: An island restaurant in Janadō that the Okinawa Times profiles for its spread of local seafood — Kume-jima's farmed kuruma-ebi prawns, mozuku seaweed, and ikasumi-jiru squid-ink soup — drawing both tourists and residents. The Kume-jima Tourism Association lists it among the island's eateries and notes the soups can be added to a lunch set cheaply.
